name: Manual Pit Lane
author: Kizi
description: Drive the pit lane and park on your marks yourself while the crew does the stop. Use the game's Immersive pit stops; the quick-time event is removed. Ctrl+F7 switches it. Experimental.

options.label: Drive the pit lane yourself
options.description: On: the game no longer takes over your car in the pit lane. Ctrl+F7 switches it in a race.

options.label: Pit stop
options.description: Manual: you park on your marks and the crew does the stop (use Immersive pit stops). AI parks the car: the AI drives you into the box. No flashback during a stop.

options.label: Remove the pit stop quick-time event
options.description: Hides the pit stop quick-time event for your car in the pit lane, like Broadcast, with no time lost.

options.label: On-screen messages
options.description: Shows on-screen messages in the game's race notification.
